title: Chinese and Western Weddings
synopsis: Here are the main differences between weddings in China and America.

fullText.simplified:
中西婚礼的不同

    你有没有参加过中国人的婚礼？中国婚礼和美国婚礼有很多不一样的地方。
    首先是拍婚纱照的时间不同。中国人一般在婚礼前拍婚纱照，然后把婚纱照用在请帖和婚礼会场上。而美国人则喜欢在仪式和招待晚宴中间的一段时间拍照。
    其次是服装的不同。在中国，新郎新娘一天会换至少两套衣服：一套西式礼服和一套中式礼服。宾客们的服装一般则比较随便，平常穿什么就是什么。而在美国，新郎新娘一天都穿同一套衣服，不会更换。大部分宾客都会着盛装出席。
    最后是送礼的不同。在中国，宾客们一般不送礼，而是包红包，也就是把钱放到红包里，送给新婚夫妇。至于包多少钱，每个地方的标准都不一样。一般来说，关系普通的朋友包200-500元；关系很好的朋友包500-1000元；亲戚包1000元以上。而在美国，新婚夫妇会收到很多礼物，但很少会收到现金作为礼物。
fullText.traditional:
中西婚禮的不同

    你有沒有參加過中國人的婚禮？中國婚禮和美國婚禮有很多不一樣的地方。
    首先是拍婚紗照的時間不同。中國人一般在婚禮前拍婚紗照，然後把婚紗照用在請帖和婚禮會場上。而美國人則喜歡在儀式和招待晚宴中間的一段時間拍照。
    其次是服裝的不同。在中國，新郎新娘一天會換至少兩套衣服：一套西式禮服和一套中式禮服。賓客們的服裝一般則比較隨便，平常穿什麼就是什麼。而在美國，新郎新娘一天都穿同一套衣服，不會更換。大部分賓客都會著盛裝出席。
    最後是送禮的不同。在中國，賓客們一般不送禮，而是包紅包，也就是把錢放到紅包裡，送給新婚夫婦。至於包多少錢，每個地方的標準都不一樣。一般來說，關係普通的朋友包200-500元；關係很好的朋友包500-1000元；親戚包1000元以上。而在美國，新婚夫婦會收到很多禮物，但很少會收到現金作為禮物。

There are many differences between Chinese weddings and American weddings.

raw.synopsis: Here are the main differences between weddings in China and America.
sentence_translations: Differences between Chinese and Western weddings
Have you ever been to a wedding between Chinese people?
There are many differences between Chinese weddings and American weddings.
First of all wedding photos are taken at different times.
Chinese people generally take wedding photos before the wedding, ..
.. and then use the wedding photos on the invitations and at the wedding venue.
In contrast, Americans like to take photos during the time between the ceremony and the wedding banquet.
Next is the different clothes.
In China, the bridegroom and bride will have at least two changes of outfits on the day: ..
.. one Western style outfit and one Chinese style outfit.
The guests’ outfits are in contrast generally relatively casual: they usually wear their normal clothes.
However in America, the bridegroom and bride wear the same outfit all day, and don’t change their outfit.
Most of the guests will wear their best attire to attend the wedding.
Finally there are differences in gift giving.
In China, guests generally don’t give gifts, but give red envelopes, ..
.. they put money inside the red envelopes to give to the newly wedded couple.
As for how much money to put in the red envelope, each region has different standards.
Generally speaking, if you are ordinary friends, give 200-500 yuan.
If you are very good friends, give 500-1000 yuan.
If you are relatives, give 1000 yuan or more.
However in America, a newly wedded couple will receive a lot of gifts, ..
.. but very few will receive cash as a gift.
